wins: Completed initial reconnaissance and enumerated available services within first 5 minutes, establishing a reliable baseline for future attacks.
Maintained consistent observation of network behaviors throughout the episode despite lack of success, providing comprehensive data for analysis.
fails: Failed to progress from enumeration to exploitation, resulting in a 0% success rate despite high reward indicating partial objectives were met.
Missed opportunities to leverage the identified services for credential-based attacks, likely due to insufficient preparatory skill triggers.
key_outcomes.summary: The run demonstrated disciplined reconnaissance but failed to transition into exploitation, suggesting a gap between detection and attack execution phases.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Always stopping after enumeration without launching exploitation or privilege escalation attempts.

skill_cards.if_condition: When port 22 is open and SSH banner indicates outdated service
skill_cards.then_action: Run SSH enumeration with nmap scripts and attempt default credential brute-force.

skill_cards.if_condition: When HTTP service returns a directory listing or unusual headers
skill_cards.then_action: Execute targeted directory brute-force and check for common CMS panels or outdated software versions.

skill_cards.if_condition: When enumeration reveals a writable file share
skill_cards.then_action: Attempt to stage a custom payload or drop a webshell via smbclient or curl upload.

memory_ops.reason: High success potential in reconnaissance phase when SSH service present and vulnerable banner detected.

next_experiments.title: Extend enumeration to exploitation
next_experiments.description: After identifying open services, immediately queue targeted exploitation attempts (e.g., default creds, known CVEs) to close the loop on reconnaissance.

next_experiments.title: Automate conditional skill chaining
next_experiments.description: Create a flow that triggers skill_002 only if HTTP enumeration yields directory listings, ensuring deeper coverage without manual intervention.

next_experiments.title: Evaluate payload staging opportunities
next_experiments.description: Test dropping benign payloads on writable shares to verify exploitation prep, improving confidence for actual attacks.
